chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah said:

Abu Basir asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) while I was present, saying: 'When I have applied the perfume for the first Ihram, what should I do regarding the final perfume, and what is the time between them?' He said: 'If there are two Fridays (fifteen days) between them, then apply the perfume.'

key_terms.أَبُو بَصِير: A companion of the Imams, Abu Basir al-Mudhary
key_terms.الْإِحْرَام: The state of consecration for Hajj or Umrah
key_terms.جُمْعَتَانِ: Two Fridays (used here to denote a period of fifteen days)

ai.seo_question: How often should a pilgrim reapply perfume during Ihram if the duration is fifteen days?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the practical duration of the 'state of perfume' (talay) for pilgrims, establishing a fifteen-day period marked by two Fridays as the threshold for reapplication. It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on precise ritual timing, ensuring that the physical state of Ihram is not compromised by lingering scents beyond the permissible window.
